That volume does not cover Atlas's workload or demonstrate the full contracted workflow. No commercial pilot is authorized yet, and no production routing will change on this message.

Today's 15:00 session will assign the mapping, connector and invoicing work and settle the exact pilot mode and required signatures. RelayGrid owns the retry correction and coordination; Northstar owns its mapping and adapter, and Vela confirms business quantities and access. The late data file does not establish that Vela caused the whole delay. The next evidence review is June 13 at 10:00, followed by a delivery decision at 11:00. Those are decision times, not guaranteed readiness.

The final $20,000 milestone remains unissued and blocked pending full acceptance. No new support purchase is required for contracted correction or the sixty approved RelayGrid engineering hours. Premier Care would not guarantee this launch or partner staffing. If you choose the legacy extension, RelayGrid has approved reimbursement of verified cost up to $12,000; the existing quote is $9,600 for June 16–25 and needs your instruction before June 13 noon. Payment has not been made and normal finance processing follows your choice and verification.

The Atlas notice deadline is June 13 at 16:00 and its June 16 requirement remains at risk; only Atlas can waive it. The team can supply accurate supplier facts for your notice. Please confirm whether to develop the pilot proposal and who can operate it; the team already has the order, quote and test references. You retain the choice to keep the new route inactive and request a wider commercial review. No scope change or acceptance will be inferred.
